Game Overview

Twin Ninja is a action game built around master the art of dual control as two nimble ninjas race through intricate landscapes. Stay sharp and coordinate jumps with precision to dodge obstacles. Experience the rush of quick decision-making and enjoy the mesmerizing monochrome world where timing and agility are everything. Can you outlast the endless run?
